During a call

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

Mute turns off the microphone. Keys opens the keypad and Hide closes it. Speaker sends the sound to the speaker. Hold puts the call on hold and Resume continues it. End call ends the call.

Add call opens a contact list. You can search with Search contacts, jump with the letter picker or type a number with Dial a number. With two calls you can join them with Merge.

If a Bluetooth headset or watch is connected, the Bluetooth button appears and sends the sound to it; with several devices a list opens to choose from. For the devices to appear, grant the Bluetooth call devices permission once in the Permissions and Privacy section of Settings.

With Automatic Speaker on, the speaker is used while the phone is away from your ear and the earpiece while it is close. This setting is in the Accessibility section.

The Phone Settings section has two more settings: Keep Screen On During Calls and Keypad During Calls.
